title: Stabilizing the Modality Gap: Null-Space Projected Continual Learning for Vision-Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2507.19839v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The modality gap is intrinsic to multimodal alignment, where embeddings from different modalities remain partially separated in a shared representation space. In continual learning, CLIP-based vision-language models (VLMs) not only suffer catastrophic forgetting but also experience modality gap drift that disrupts the shared embedding geometry. Such drift degrades cross-modal alignment and generalization. We propose FPCD, an efficient framework combining Fast Null-space Projection (FNP) and Contrastive Distillation (CD). FNP accumulates compact Gram matrices of previous tasks' activations and projects gradients onto layer-adaptive approximate null spaces to reduce interference with learned representations. By replacing singular value decomposition with symmetric eigendecomposition, FNP accelerates projection-basis construction by a factor of 5-9. CD uses a small reference set to align the bidirectional image-to-text and text-to-image

translated_title: 稳定模态间隙：面向视觉-语言模型的零空间投影持续学习
translated_abstract: 模态间隙是多模态对齐的固有特性，即来自不同模态的嵌入在共享表示空间中仍保持部分分离。在持续学习中，基于CLIP的视觉-语言模型（VLMs）不仅遭受灾难性遗忘，还会经历模态间隙漂移，破坏共享嵌入的几何结构。这种漂移会降低跨模态对齐能力和泛化能力。我们提出了FPCD，一个结合快速零空间投影（FNP）和对比蒸馏（CD）的高效框架。FNP累积先前任务激活的紧凑Gram矩阵，并将梯度投影到层自适应的近似零空间上，以减少对已学习表示的干扰。通过用对称特征分解替代奇异值分解，FNP将投影基的构建速度提升了5-9倍。CD使用小型参考集来对齐双向的图像到文本和文本到图像的（跨模态映射，摘要此处截断）。
tldr: 提出FPCD框架，通过快速零空间投影减少对已学习表示的干扰，并结合对比蒸馏对齐跨模态映射，从而稳定视觉-语言模型持续学习中的模态间隙漂移，同时将投影基构建速度提升5-9倍。
